action_scale_finding.conclusion: The raw 7D LIBERO action fields use controller command units with heterogeneous per-dimension ranges; this is not by itself a data defect.
action_scale_finding.physical_state_vs_action: A physical EEF displacement around +/-0.1 must not be compared directly with the raw action field.
action_scale_finding.normalization_in_current_pi05_path: Pi05 uses per-dimension q01/q99 normalization to approximately [-1,1], then applies the matching inverse transform at deployment.
action_scale_finding.risk_to_check_in_other_export_paths: Any MEAN_STD exporter or deployment path must not be mixed with the q01/q99 checkpoint contract.
